entities.summary: Mahamahopadhyaya T. Gaṇapati Śāstrī (1860–1926) was a Sanskrit scholar who was editor of the Trivandrum Sanskrit Series, and discovered the plays of Bhasa. He was also the principal of the Sanskrit college for some time, around 1903. His father name is Ramasubba Iyer. He was born at Taruvai in Tirunelveli District in 1860 A.D
